description: Open a URL in a new browser tab. The new tab becomes the one every later page action targets, unless "active" is false.

active.description: Bring the new tab to the front, making it the tab later page actions target. Set false to open it in the background and leave the current tab in front.

url.description: Absolute or relative URL to open in the new tab (http/https only).

name: page_openTab
